teamAnalysis: Compliance and origin remain primary drivers of landed cost, overshadowing spot prices. EU buyers face tightening EUDR, CBAM (with Q2 2026 certificate price now EUR 75.28 per tonne), and the application of PPWR PFAS limits from August 12, 2026, with EUDR implementation deadlines holding firm despite IT system challenges. US and Canadian costs are shaped by tariff stacks and country-of-origin/melt rules, with new US tariff measures now in effect. Ocean freight trends are mixed, with Transpacific rates sharply increasing (NY up 3%, LA up 5%) while Asia-Europe rates are softening (Rotterdam down 5%, Genoa down 10%). Brent crude surged to $107.63 USD per barrel on September 10, 2026, as the Strait of Hormuz remains severely disrupted, keeping energy-linked input costs highly volatile, while polypropylene resin prices continue to soften. These market dynamics reinforce the importance of securing supply, capacity, and robust documentation early. Birdland's two-country production model, proactive freight booking, strategic material locking, and comprehensive compliance paperwork ensure stable supply and protect your margins amidst ongoing volatility.

advice.zh: 【Birdland 供應鏈週報】本週亞洲—美西運價因GRI與港口擁堵而上漲 (紐約漲 3%, 洛杉磯漲 5%), 亞洲—歐洲海運運價回軟 (鹿特丹跌 5%, 熱那亞跌 10%); 北美鋼價受關稅支撐穩定,全球趨勢分歧,中國鋼廠減產護價; 木材與塑膠粒則持續走軟。 Brent原油因荷姆茲海峽局勢高度不穩，伊朗持續針對商業航運而飆升至 $107.63 美元/桶。 建議:海運運價混合走勢,應戰略性訂艙,並分批鎖定鋼質料件與燃料相關投入。美方新關稅措施已生效,請留意。 法規面 EUDR(2026/12/30)木柄文件請務必提早備齊,並留意PPWR(2026/8/12)對包裝PFAS的限制,該限制已生效。 需要我們協助規劃備料節奏與文件,隨時聯繫。
advice.en: [Birdland Supply-Chain Brief] Transpacific ocean freight rates have sharply increased (New York up 3%, Los Angeles up 5%), while Asia–Europe rates are softening (Rotterdam down 5%, Genoa down 10%); North American steel prices are stable, supported by tariffs, while global trends are mixed with China mills cutting production to defend prices; lumber and resin continue to soften. Brent crude surged to $107.63 USD/bbl on September 10, 2026, as the Strait of Hormuz remains severely disrupted with Iran continuing to target commercial shipping. We suggest strategically booking ocean space given the mixed freight trends, and phasing in steel-input and fuel-linked cover. New US tariff measures are now in effect, requiring close monitoring. On compliance, prepare EUDR (30 Dec 2026) timber documentation early and thoroughly, and note PPWR (12 Aug 2026) PFAS limits for packaging, which are now in effect. Contact us to plan your buying cadence and paperwork.

materials_bot.simple: 原料像做菜的食材——鋼和包材在漲、木材和塑膠在跌,整體成本『一半漲一半跌』,不會單看一項就決定報價。
expert: 對台灣出口:鋼與電鍍/包材偏漲,鋼質手工具到岸成本壓力升,建議分批鎖鋼料、優化包材規格。
對中國出口:木材與樹膠走軟有利木柄/握把成本,但 EUDR(木材)合規文件成關鍵門檻。
綜合:成本結構分散,維持台灣+中國雙基地調度,用『鎖料+文件齊備』把波動轉成穩定供應的賣點。

shipping_bot.simple: 海運成本像搭車的車資——歐洲線塞車漲價、美西順暢降價;港口和拖車的『小費』也在變。
expert: 對台灣/中國出口:歐洲線運價與旺季附加偏漲,建議提前訂艙、鎖長約;美西回軟可保留彈性。
內陸拖運與海關倉儲/查驗成本上升,出貨節奏與文件齊備能直接省下滯港與查驗成本。
綜合:把運費波動納入報價(BAF/PSS 先估),用提前佈局把不確定變可預期,是對客戶最有價值的服務。

reg_bot.simple: 法規像考試規則一直在改——歐美越來越看『木材哪來的、鋼的碳排多少、有沒有強迫勞動』,文件不齊就卡關。
expert: 對台灣出口:CBAM(鋼)、EUDR(木)文件成歐洲市場門檻;台灣熔煉鋼還能規避加拿大附加稅,是優勢。
對中國出口:原產地查驗趨嚴 + 美 UFLPA,『中國製』暴露於關稅與審查,雙基地調度與產地文件是關鍵。
綜合:把『合規文件齊備』做成標準服務,等於替客戶清掉通關風險,是最強的差異化。
